Title: Able2Shell N-central zero-days - ipv4
Description: Source of 68 Able2Shell exploitation attempts against Previdian's N-central decoy from 9 November, including XXE and /etc/passwd reads, and host of the a.dtd and svc.xml payload files. Source: Previdian – N-able N-central critical vulnerabilities: what we know so far https://blog.previdian.com/n-able-n-central-critical-vulnerabilities-what-we-know-so-far/
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.

Title: Able2Shell N-central zero-days - ipv4
Description: Source of 4EverAble2Shell exploitation against live N-central servers on 12 November, and of earlier probing seen by Previdian. huntback saw this address probe its decoys, then run the full chain (code execution as the nable user, root through nable_wrapper.pl, then curl of jup.sh to install an XMRig miner). It also hosts the installer on TCP 8080 and opens a TCP callback on ports 19202 to 19418. By 12:50 UTC, 21 production N-central servers, 19 already on 2026.4 HF2, were listed as nc_ rigs on the operator's mining pool. Source: The Hacker News – New N-central exploits work against patched servers, enable root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/new-n-central-exploits-work-against.html; The Hacker News – Recently patched N-central servers remain exploitable (X) https://x.com/TheHackersNews/status/2120834921241694544; huntback Research – 4EverAble2Shell exploited: Monero miners on live N-central https://huntback.io/blog/ncentral-4everable2shell-miners-on-live-servers; BleepingComputer – New N-able 4EverAble2Shell zero-day exploited hours after PoC released https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/new-n-able-4everable2shell-zero-day-exploited-hours-after-poc-released/
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
